requiredBehaviors.behavior: separate claimed features from disclosed embodiments and experimentally demonstrated data
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Evidenzmodell keeps CLAIMED, disclosed embodiments and EXPERIMENTALLY_DEMONSTRATED data as distinct evidence states.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: map sequence IDs to antibody domains and claim or example references
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The sequence/konstrukt workflow maps VH/VL, CDRs, domains and claim-relevant sequence relationships while retaining patent references.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: retain assay method and measurement context for binding data
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The binding/performance workflow requires value, unit, molecule ID, method/platform, assay context, source and measurementContextCompleteness.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: produce a reconstruction baseline using only publicly supported details
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The reconstructionBaseline is expressly limited to publicly supported components, sequences, interactions, parameters and evidence gaps.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat a competition-binding claim as proof of an exact residue epitope
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The epitope section explicitly says a Competition-Binding-Definition is not automatically an exact residue epitope.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent missing CDRs sequences affinities or assay conditions
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The boundary and reconstruction sections prohibit inventing missing sequences, affinities, recipes or laboratory conditions.
